assets.role: Perched adult male with slate-blue upperparts, orange cheeks, fine orange breast barring and a long barred tail.
Adult in flight with a deeply forked rufous tail, pale streaked head and white panels inside black wingtips.
Upright adult with slate-blue back, black hood and moustache, barred pale belly, yellow eye-ring and feet.
Adult with a white heart-shaped facial disc and underparts, dark eyes and golden-buff and grey upperparts.
Adult of the rich brown form with a rounded head, mottled brown plumage and large dark eyes.
Adult with a low flat head, white-spotted brown back, yellow eyes and strong white eyebrows.
Adult with purple-glossed black plumage, bare pale bill base, peaked crown and shaggy leg feathers.
Adult with blue-grey plumage, green neck gloss, pink breast, dark eye and two short black wing bars.
